item.title: [News] Ennostar Boosts Blue Micro LED Modulation Bandwidth More Than Tenfold to 2.1 GHz
item.description: Ennostar today announced a breakthrough in Micro LED optical communications. The company’s R&D team has increased the single-channel -3 dB modulation bandwidth of its blue Micro LED to 2.1 GHz at a current density of 2 kA/cm². The sample further demonstrated a modulation bandwidth of up to 3.3 GHz at a current density of 5 kA/cm2.
